boundary: IEC GSU HV bushing terminals; EPC conductors/cable, clamps, surge arresters at the bushings and the GIS bay.
connection: GSU HV air bushings, EPC 420 kV connection to the GIS
isolation: EPC GIS generator transformer bay circuit breaker, disconnector and earthing switch; IEC GCB on the LV side.
operating_conditions: OLTC 400 +/- 8 x 1.25 % (360-440 kV) with generator 21 kV +/- 5 % covers 342-420 kV.
protection: GSU differential (87T) and overall differential (87G-T) by IEC; GIS bay protection by EPC; trip matrix per IF-41.
